description: This file defines a React functional component named CloudBackupProvider that manages cloud backup integrations within a web application. It includes functionality for enabling/disabling backups, performing manual backups, handling authentication workflows with different cloud providers, and rendering related UI elements.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Handles disabling the cloud backup integration by deleting relevant settings after user confirmation.

methods.name: installIntegration
methods.description: Initiates the cloud provider authentication process by opening an external URL in a new tab.

methods.name: performBackupNow
methods.description: Triggers an immediate backup by updating the backup frequency setting.

methods.name: getCloudProviderIntegrationTokenFromUrl
methods.description: Extracts the integration token from a callback URL based on the cloud provider.

methods.name: handleKeyPress
methods.description: Handles the 'Enter' key press event to process the confirmation code entered by the user for authentication.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Updates the confirmation code state when user input changes.

methods.name: getIntegrationStatus
methods.description: Fetches and sets the current backup frequency setting for the cloud provider.
